name: Remesh
description:
Remesh is a research platform for structured conversations with hundreds of real participants at once, combining open-ended responses with polls, rankings, and audience segmentation.

The Remesh connector securely links your Remesh workspace so you can work across the full research loop:

Design and launch. Turn a research objective into a discussion guide, build and refine questions, recruit targeted audiences, and schedule conversations.

Analyze and synthesize. Explore results across topics, sentiment, poll statistics, and audience segments. Pull verbatim responses and findings from one or many studies into summaries, briefs, and reports grounded in what participants actually said.

Access is permissioned through your Remesh account, so you only see the workspaces and conversations your account can access. Requires a Remesh subscription.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Remesh to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Remesh to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://live.remesh.chat/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Remesh MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Remesh lists 52 MCP tools, including apply_recruit_audience, continue_auto_dg_flow, create_conversation, create_conversation_messages, create_sections, delete_message, delete_section, duplicate_conversation, duplicate_message, duplicate_section, estimate_audience_count, and export_conversation_data.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Remesh?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Remesh in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Remesh requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Remesh is developed by Remesh Inc. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
